answer: Randomized Slot Assignment uses a public threshold beacon to map each live agent to a rotating work slot, an ivory ledger recording only slot hashes. An identity holding no slot cannot submit or earn until the next beacon round. Because beacon outputs are unpredictable before commit, an attacker cannot precompute which duplicates land slots, so each extra identity buys only a lottery draw and pays full registration and idle upkeep per round. Rewards summit only for slots actually filled, capping the trellis of viable identities at the real work available.
